title: docs(pm-dispatch): runbook patrol names the per-seat patrol and dedupes review claims by seat
body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiHXKqxUqDPJKZyNHP7BoqTb)_
Fixes #28740
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:派发手册〈巡查常设项〉三行措辞:标题与跨账户复审行由「每项目巡查」改为「每席巡查」,复核认领去重从「他账户」改为「他席(同账户亦然)」。
- 为什么改:技能其余处已是「每席一个巡查」;旧去重按账户判,同一账户在同项目坐多席时两席都会放行,可能对同一 PR 重复复核。
- 风险与回滚:纯文面改动,不动脚本与门禁;「剔除本账户署名的 PR」这条复核独立性规则保持按账户不变。回滚即还原这一个提交。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` 第 45 行(去重键从账户改为席位)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep 每项目巡查 -- .claude` 应零命中;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 应通过(净行数 0)。
- 需要你做的:审阅并批准本 PR(规则文本改动以维护者批准为裁决),之后由席位落地。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`, section 巡查常设项, three lines (3 insertions, 3 deletions, net 0):

- L39 heading: 「每项目巡查与总监席摘要」 becomes 「每席巡查与总监席摘要」.
- L44 cross-account review line: 「每项目巡查跑」 becomes 「每席巡查跑」. Its exclusion 「剔除本账户署名的 PR」 is the review-independence rule and stays keyed to the account.
- L45 review-claim dedupe: 「已有他账户的认领即跳过」 becomes 「已有他席认领即跳过(同账户亦然)」, so a PR already claimed by another seat is skipped even when that seat sits on the same account. The `Claim:` form (会话、账户) is unchanged; no new field.

## Tests

Prose-only change to a governed skill reference; no code, no package, no test surface. `skip-changeset`: nothing publishes.

## Acceptance notes

- Byte widths after the edit: L39 50 B, L44 108 B, L45 119 B, all within the 120-byte cap (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`). The first L45 spelling measured 122 B and was shortened by dropping one particle.
- `git grep 每项目巡查` over the whole tree: 0 hits after the edit. The only other mention of the section, `lanes/director.md` L74, cites it as 巡查常设项 and still resolves.
- Read against `contract-review.md` and `seat-lifecycle.md`: neither keys reviewer independence or the review-claim dedupe differently; `cross-repo-coordination.md` already uses 他席 for another seat's claim.
